entries.2aee6c44d61e8d4f: It consists of TANSEISHA CO.,LTD. and six subsidiaries. The consolidated number of employees for the fiscal year ended January 2026 is 1,579.
entries.2dde84f6576336ab: It has a structure that allows the group to handle everything consistently from research and study through planning, design, construction and supervision. On the production side, Tansei TDC and Tansei Display handle construction; on the software side, Tansei Research Institute handles research on cultural facilities; and JDN handles information provision services using a Web site, dividing the work while collaborating. Since the Japan World Exposition in 1970, it has repeatedly handled pavilion exhibits and interiors at large-scale expositions, including the Tsukuba Science Expo, the 2005 Japan International Exposition and the 2025 Osaka-Kansai Expo, and has a track record to show for it.

entries.ccadfa7b06b1292c: Under its purpose, 'Drawing the future from space, bringing tansei (irodori) to people and society,' it works on creating spaces that move people's hearts. In February 2024, it formulated 'Our Future Vision 2046,' aimed at 2046, the 100th anniversary of its founding. Under its medium-term management plan (fiscal years ended January 2025 to January 2027), its key measures are building the foundation for work style and human capital, building the foundation for marketing, building the foundation for the supply chain, building the foundation for sustainability response, and challenging new domains; based on the recent business environment, it has revised its financial targets for the final fiscal year upward. By business, it aims to capture new and renovation demand in the entertainment field, hotels, and stadiums and arenas in the Commercial and Other Facilities Business; expand share with existing customers and the maintenance field in the Chain Store Business; and expand orders centered on projects related to regional revitalization and public-private partnerships in the Cultural Facilities Business.

entries.ea4cd8829a24de03: There are three reportable segments: the Commercial and Other Facilities Business, the Chain Store Business and the Cultural Facilities Business; in addition, there is an 'Other' category that is not included in reportable segments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was largest in the Commercial and Other Facilities Business at ¥72,154 million (up 32.6% year on year), followed by the Chain Store Business at ¥25,619 million (down 5.4% year on year), the Cultural Facilities Business at ¥8,929 million (down 10.0% year on year), and Other at ¥519 million (up 12.3% year on year). Because revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue, geographic information is omitted. No customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.
